event.description: Registration is required. Seats are limited. Please only register if you plan on attending. Are you learning or improving your spoken English? Come practice with us! Each week we discuss a different topic with related vocabulary, idioms, and conversation questions. We will meet in person in the first-floor program room. Casual conversation and friendly company. Everyone is welcome. This class is intended for adults, ages 18 and up only.

event.title: Kids Knitting (Ages 7+)

event.description: For ages 7+ only: Join Librarian Robert in the Children's Room and learn to knit! Learn the basic skills to get started on a simple project and practice your stitching.

event.title: Storytime (Ages 0-5)

event.description: Early learners (babies and toddlers) and their families are welcome to join us at the Library for Storytime, where we will wiggle, sing, read, and dance together! Our program is developmentally appropriate for ages 0-5, and our goal is to create memories and special bonds between caregivers and their children, and to help with building skills for school readiness and for a future of loving books!

event.title: Girls Who Code
event.address: 110 E Main St, Los Gatos, CA 95030
event.blurb: Learn to code alongside other teens and work on projects that put your skills toward real community problems.
event.description: The Los Gatos Library has partnered with @Girls Who Code to create a club meant for people ages 12-18 to learn to code and change the world! "What will I learn? Our middle and high school clubs encourage you to impact the community in a positive way through code. In order to build the skills you need to make an impact, you will learn how to code from our fun online tutorials and activities that will help you build animations, games, apps, and other things that you dream up! We have tutorials in Python, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, and Java." Email: signup@gwc-losgatos.org to register.

event.title: Choose Your Own Adventure Book Club

We will read the story together, vote on which direction to take, then see where our choice takes us! Each participant will receive a free book and an Adventure Passport to track the books they've read. Open to ages 5-8.

This group is entirely self-directed and you are encouraged to bring your own tools and materials. If you are looking for some inspiration or don't know where to start, check out Creativebug - it's free with your library card and offers hundreds of project ideas and instructions.
